title: "How life expectancy change over time for each continent?"

  html_document:
    theme: spacelab
    highlight: pygments

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# cache results
knitr::opts_chunk$set(cache=TRUE, message=FALSE)
```

Life expectancy for a country is the mean length of life over people of a country. Using variables life expectancy and population of a country:

1.  derive a formula to compute life expectancy of a continent (a group of countries)
2.  plot how life expectancy changed over time for each continent
3.  do the same for the whole planet

## Our solution

### 1. 

$$
LE_C = \frac{\sum_{y}\sum_{c \ \in \ C} LE_{c,y}\cdot pop_{c,y}}{\sum_{y}\sum_{c \ \in \ C} pop_{c,y}} \qquad y = year, c = country, C = continent
$$


```{r}
library(gapminder)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(shiny)

gap_y <- gapminder |>
  group_by(continent, year) |>
  summarise(
    pop_tot_y = sum(pop),
    lifeExpC_y = sum(lifeExp * pop) / pop_tot_y
  ) 

gap_y |>
  select(-pop_tot_y)


gap_y |>
  summarise(
    lifeExpC = sum(lifeExpC_y * pop_tot_y) / sum(pop_tot_y)
  )
```

Using non-weighted mean:

```{r}

gap_y |>
  summarise(
    lifeExpC = mean(lifeExpC_y)
  )
```


### 2.

```{r}
gap_y |>
  select(-pop_tot_y) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = lifeExpC_y, group = continent, color = continent)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "Evoluzione dell'Aspettativa di Vita per Paese",
    subtitle = "Dataset Gapminder",
    x = "Anno",
    y = "Aspettativa di Vita (anni)",
    color = "Continente"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
gap_p_y <- gapminder |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(
    pop_tot_p_y = sum(pop),
    lifeExp_p_y = sum(lifeExp * pop) / pop_tot_p_y
  ) 

gap_p_y

gap_p_y |>
  summarise(
    lifeExp_p = sum(lifeExp_p_y * pop_tot_p_y) / sum(pop_tot_p_y)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Planet = c("Earth")
  ) |>
  select(Planet, lifeExp_p)
```

```{r}
gap_p_y |>
  select(-pop_tot_p_y) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = lifeExp_p_y, color = c("Earth"))) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "Evoluzione dell'Aspettativa di Vita per Paese",
    subtitle = "Dataset Gapminder",
    x = "Anno",
    y = "Aspettativa di Vita (anni)",
    color = "Planet"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
